currentFocus.title: Define the SQL-first LIVE analytical contract

baselineSource.result: The frozen V1 collector remains the verified browser-only baseline and reference.

sqlDirectionChange.requirement: The analytical layer must execute user-defined SQL automatically every configured X seconds, and changing the analytical logic should normally require changing SQL rather than application code.
sqlDirectionChange.consequence: IndexedDB is no longer the target primary analytical query engine. The prior IndexedDB-primary evaluation plan is archived as superseded.

candidateArchitectures.localhost: Browser collector to localhost native DuckDB
candidateArchitectures.sqlite: Optional control candidate only if a concrete benchmark/design question justifies it

verification.specImpact: Product/architecture direction changed. Runtime and normative V2 specs have not changed yet; SQL-specific normative specs will be created after the architecture candidate is selected.

next.action: Complete SQL-first Stage 01 before implementing a database engine.
steps: Write observable acceptance scenarios for arbitrary SQL text, configurable X-second execution and 0..N results.
Define query-error and scheduler-overrun behavior without coupling it to a specific engine.
Define the committed-data consistency boundary visible to SQL.
Then proceed to Stage 02 candidate evaluation: DuckDB-Wasm+OPFS versus localhost native DuckDB.

history.rule: Superseded architecture/research plans stay discoverable as cold history and do not carry current progress.
